no_new_call_note: No call is live to review this week -- the register is empty since last week's copper call closed. A scan across commodities, crypto and stocks turned up nothing both new and confirmed by more than one independent source that the market has not already priced: copper's push to fresh highs is being reported across outlets already, silver's sixth straight year of a supply deficit has been reported for months, the Bitcoin slide under $60,000 and the broader AI-datacenter spending worries have both been reported and argued over for weeks, and the uranium buildout story is a repeated theme across several outlets going back to September. Nothing survived the two gates -- new, multiply sourced, and tradable by an ordinary person through a normal brokerage or exchange -- so no new call opens this week.
